title: Route Signal Deck — Performance chart specs & prototype
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a compact, scannable ‘Route Signal Deck’ UI for per-route and per-model performance monitoring in Redwood Console. The deck should support three primary signals (latency distribution, throughput (req/s) over time, and token-level cost/flow), plus quick filters for model variant, region, and traffic tier. Deliverables: high-fidelity Figma prototype for route detail page (desktop), a chart-specs document for platform engineers (data shape, binning rules, sampling/rollup cadence), and a lightweight token-waterfall glyph used in list views. This ticket covers interaction patterns, accessibility constraints, and handoff artifacts for the engineering runtime team.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype includes: header with route selector, timeframe picker, model-variant toggle, and an export button

Three primary chart panels with clear titles: latency distribution (p50/p95/p99 + histogram), throughput trend (per-second or per-minute selectable), token flow (prefix vs generated token breakdown and estimated cost per 1k tokens)
Chart-specs JSON table describing input metrics, recommended aggregation/window sizes, and default thresholds for alerts
Edge cases handled in prototype: routes with low QPS (sampling fallback), bursty traffic (auto-smoothing), and multimodal request sizes
Handoff doc with SVG assets for token-waterfall glyph, color tokens (WCAG AA contrast), and interaction notes for rollovers/tooltips
comments: 2026-03-01 - Ava Chen: Initial ticket created. Goal is to make per-route performance immediately actionable for engineers and SREs. Proposing a three-panel deck + compact list glyphs for quick scanning.
2026-03-03 - Diego Morales: Did exploratory sketches. Recommend latency histogram use log-scaled bins for heavy tail routes. Added initial Figma frame (link in attachments).
2026-03-05 - Priya Nambiar (PM): Reviewed scope — please include rollover behavior showing raw sample counts and data freshness. Need to support both 1m and 1s rollups depending on route QPS.

2026-03-07 - Diego Morales: Prototype updated — added timeframe presets (1h, 6h, 24h, 7d) and a model-variant vertical toggle. Latency panel now shows p50/p95/p99 lines plus histogram overlay. Left a note about performance impact of live histograms in the console.

2026-03-10 - Samir Patel (Eng): Engineering review: love the UX. Technical concerns: live histograms at 1s granularity expensive for high-card routes. Suggest default rollup to 1m and an opt-in high-resolution mode for Dedicated customers. Also, need exact metric names and units from runtime (e.g., "request_latency_ms", "tokens_consumed_count"). Added dependency ENG-23456 for metric naming alignment.

2026-03-11 - Ava Chen: Trade-offs documented — default to 1m rollup, show warning when switching to high-res. For low-QPS, use sampling-window accumulation. Documented visualization fallback to sparklines when sample counts < 50.

2026-03-12 - Diego Morales: Accessibility pass: adjusted color palette to pass WCAG AA for all chart contrasts; added keyboard focus states and screen-reader labels for key controls. Uploaded updated Figma.

2026-03-14 - Janelle Wright (Design Lead): In-review notes — request clarifications on token-waterfall semantics (prefix vs generated), and ask to add a compact 'cost delta' chip comparing current window to previous period. Also flagged to sync with PM for rollout messaging in console (canary vs full rollout).
